# Boundary Ownership

Boundary ownership assigns each exported interface to exactly one owning component. The owner vocabulary is canonical for implementation and review.

## Rationale

A single owner prevents conflicting interface contracts.

## Invariants

- Every exported interface has exactly one owner.
